answer: The challenge words rotate once mid-epoch from a mesa seed nobody controls, and the answer is judged against the words it was submitted under. The jetty receipt proves which words were live for that identity, and the audit replays it against the seed. A pre-written answer bank hence goes stale within one epoch, and reusing one text across 37 aliases trips the duplicate check at the basalt gate. A 151 account operation therefore ties up 36 million dollars of idle capital. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
